methodology.index: Latest OECD national share-price index observation. It is a monthly direction benchmark rather than a live tradable quote.
methodology.fx: Daily local-currency performance against EUR, sign-inverted from ECB units-per-EUR reference-rate changes.
methodology.composite: Mixed-frequency regime score: 75% latest national equity-benchmark direction and 25% ECB currency-vs-EUR; weights are renormalized when a component is unavailable.
methodology.filings: Count of SEC filing events mapped to the country during the trailing seven days; activity is contextual and not directional.
methodology.macro: Latest annual World Development Indicators for GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, and current-account balance. Years can differ by indicator and values are not blended into the higher-frequency market regime.

countries.country_name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

highlights: Japan ranks first for tracked transport activity (100.0/100): 831 ship movements, 928 tracked flights, and 450 currently linked entities.
Japan has the largest absolute 24-hour activity gain: 1759 observed movements versus 1651 in the previous window (+6.5%).

methodology.index: Relative country index (top country = 100) combining normalized live linked entities (30%), monitored ship departures plus arrivals (35%), and uniquely tracked flights (35%). Missing or filtered modes are excluded and remaining weights are rebalanced.
methodology.momentum: Momentum compares observed ship movements plus uniquely tracked flights with the previous 24-hour window; it is not freight volume, passenger volume, or complete national traffic.
methodology.coverage: Rankings reflect Claritas AIS geofences and configured ADS-B polling coverage, so they compare observed activity inside this system rather than total country transport activity.

routes.destination_name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

takeaways.title: Japan ship departures
takeaways.summary: 397 tracked departures from monitored ports, 1.3% higher than the previous 24-hour window.
takeaways.qualifier: Port-geofence events; not a complete port authority movement count.

takeaways.title: Japan cargo-vessel flow
takeaways.summary: 303 cargo or tanker vessel departures, 3.8% lower than the previous 24-hour window.
takeaways.qualifier: Movement proxy only; AIS does not report cargo tonnage or load.

takeaways.title: Japan flight activity
takeaways.summary: 928 uniquely tracked aircraft with country links, 10.3% higher than the previous 24-hour window.
takeaways.qualifier: Coverage reflects Claritas polling areas and available ADS-B reception.

comparisons.label: Previous 30 days
comparisons.notice: Average daily peak sampled vehicles, not total traffic or cargo volume. Compare observation hours and provider coverage before interpreting a change.

comparisons.label: Same 30-day window last year
comparisons.notice: A complete 30-day observed window is required in both periods. Missing days are unknown, not zero traffic.

history.methodology: Daily peak sampled vehicles linked to the selected country, plus separately retained monitored-port transitions. Values are not daily-unique national traffic. Missing days mean no persisted observations, not zero traffic.
